name: maya-studio-intro
author: Alpha En
purpose: A quiet work setting connects with the professionals, creatives, and entrepreneurs named in the profile; it is atmospheric imagery, not the practice office.

name: maya-studio-anxiety
author: Nothing Ahead
purpose: Soft daylight and repeated shadows create a simple, grounded visual beside anxiety and panic support.

name: maya-studio-trauma
author: Rahime Gül
purpose: A sheltered threshold and a gently turning path support carefully paced trauma work without depicting distress or making a claim about outcomes.

name: maya-studio-burnout
author: Cup of Couple
purpose: A closed notebook and a ceramic cup suggest a pause from work; the muted plum cover ties the image to the accent palette.

name: maya-studio-statement
author: 强 任 (@rendy)
purpose: Light filtering through tactile linen gives the statement a quiet visual pause; it is not presented as the actual office.

name: maya-studio-bridge
author: Jonathan Borba
purpose: A real window, natural light, and soft curtains continue the architectural visual language between office and approach details; not a photograph of the practice.

name: maya-studio-closing
author: Lara Farber
purpose: A small ceramic detail in window light provides a human everyday ending without another landscape or additional practice claim.

name: maya-studio-hero-detail
author: Karola G
purpose: Houseplant leaf shadows on a soft beige wall give the hero a small, calm daylight detail beside the office photograph; atmospheric imagery, not the practice.

name: maya-studio-begin
author: Magda Ehlers
purpose: A brick path curving under trees in dappled light suggests a first step forward beside the closing invitation; atmospheric imagery, not the practice.
